policy: Manually reviewed aggregate asking-price observations for import planning. Listings, seller text, contacts, and photos are not republished. These are not completed sales, export quotes, or live inventory.

observations.sampleVariant: 2018 Toyota Camry petrol 2.5L, mixed LE/SE/GLE and GCC/US specifications
observations.fxSourceName: Central Bank of the UAE exchange rates, 25 September 2026
observations.method: Retained eight visible 2018 petrol 2.5L asking prices: AED 32,000, 33,000, 36,000, 38,500, 40,000, 45,000, 45,000, and 49,500. Excluded hybrid, unspecified engines, and one car disclosing damage. Interpolated quartiles, converted at 3.6725 AED per USD, and rounded the USD band to the nearest $100.
observations.limitations: The source page stated a 16 September 2026 update. Mileage spans about 57,000–250,000 km and specifications differ. Listing availability, seller independence, export suitability, freight, customs valuation, duty, clearing, and registration are not verified or included in the source asking band. Obtain a current seller quote and inspect before importing.

observations.sampleVariant: 2018 Toyota Corolla petrol 1.8L, mixed GCC and Canadian specifications
observations.fxSourceName: Central Bank of the UAE exchange rates, 25 September 2026
observations.method: The source page stated an update of 24 September 2026 and showed eighteen year-filtered results. Retained four distinct 2018 petrol 1.8L asks: AED 27,999, 28,000, 33,500, and 38,000. Excluded 1.6L and engine-unspecified cars, and one card labelled 2018 whose description said 2019 and whose fuel field said hybrid. Interpolated quartiles, converted at 3.6725 AED per USD, then rounded the USD band to the nearest $100.
observations.limitations: Only four matching offers were visible, so this is a low-confidence purchase-price snapshot, not an export quote. Regional specifications and mileage vary; one listing's displayed mileage unit conflicts with its description. Seller independence, availability, export eligibility, freight, customs valuation, duty, clearing, and registration are unverified. Get an exact seller quote and vehicle inspection before importing.

observations.sampleVariant: 2018 Toyota RAV4 petrol 2.5L, mixed LE/XLE/Limited/EX/VX trims and GCC/North American specifications
observations.fxSourceName: Central Bank of the UAE exchange rates, 25 September 2026
observations.method: Retained ten visible 2018 petrol 2.5L asking prices: AED 38,500, 39,000, 40,000, 41,100, 44,300, 45,000, 53,000, 55,000, 55,000, and 68,100. Excluded a AED 20,000 offer with conflicting regional-spec claims, AED 923,000 apparent data error, 2.4L and unspecified engines, a listing with conflicting displayed and described asks, a disclosed accident, and a 300,000 km car outside this sample's mileage band. Interpolated quartiles; converted at 3.6725 AED per USD, rounded to the nearest $100.
observations.limitations: The source page stated a 16 September 2026 update. Sample mileage spans about 88,000–210,000 km and trims/specifications differ. Availability, seller independence, export suitability, freight, customs valuation, duty, clearing, and registration are not verified or included. Obtain a current seller quote and inspect before importing.
